assets.name: portal_beyond
assets.prompt:

An immense luminous mathematics/proofs dimension under a pearlescent lavender and warm pale-pink sky: layered impossible stone terraces, elegant suspended bridges and thin geometric towers receding far into soft atmospheric mist. A few massive floating cubic architectural blocks hang at great distance, not a repeated pattern of flat icons.
